A '''Guard dog''' is an aggressive [[Dog (race)|dog]] found on the furnished and warped floors in [[Daemonheim]]. They drop coins and food as well as torn bags. On the warped floors, part of their bodies have been warped and are composed of what appears to be magma, ostensibly due to the magic that permeates the warped floors. Their specific elemental weakness varies between individual guard dogs.
